preamble: Clean, quiet game-interface texture art for a fantasy grand-strategy game, painted but restrained: matte surfaces, very fine and low-contrast material texture visible only at close view, flat even diffuse light, every plate lit uniformly from edge to edge with no vignette, no gradient, no glare, no darker or lighter corners, no wear marks, no stains. The neutral family used in every window: blackened iron plate (#282B2C) with a thin muted-bronze rim (#CAB289) and four tiny corner studs, smooth and matte.
tail: No cast shadows outside the plates, no text, no letters, no numbers, no runes, no figures, no faces, no animal heads, no crosses, no sun discs, no skulls, no crowns, no modern objects. No signature or maker's mark. The corners and the bottom edge of the image hold only the plain black ground.
layoutNote: Every cell holds one empty wide rectangular button plate about three times as wide as tall, centred in its cell with black around it, all plates the same size and shape; each row shows the same button in five states left to right, so the states differ only as described. No label on any button.
